dashboard.label: Detection Factory Control Plane
dashboard.description: Detection-as-code lifecycle, live dispatch assurance, ATT&CK coverage, and promotion evidence.

div.p: Specification → package → dispatch → evidence → promotion. Every metric resolves to a deployed knowledge object.

search.query: | inputlookup detection_catalog | stats count as value
| inputlookup detection_validation | stats count(eval(result_count>0)) as value
| inputlookup detection_validation | stats avg(runtime_seconds) as average_seconds | eval value=round(average_seconds*1000,0) | fields value
| inputlookup detection_validation | stats count(eval(NOT like(validation_state,"PASS%"))) as value

| inputlookup detection_catalog | eval lifecycle=case(status="PRODUCTION","Evidence-backed",status="TESTING","Validation queue",1=1,status) | stats count as analytics by lifecycle | append [| inputlookup detection_validation | stats count(eval(result_count>0)) as analytics | eval lifecycle="Scenario-positive"] | append [| inputlookup detection_validation | stats count(eval(like(validation_state,"PASS%"))) as analytics | eval lifecycle="Dispatch-pass"] | eval order=case(lifecycle="Dispatch-pass",1,lifecycle="Scenario-positive",2,lifecycle="Evidence-backed",3,lifecycle="Validation queue",4,1=1,99) | sort order | fields lifecycle analytics
| inputlookup detection_validation | eval analytic=replace(saved_search,"^detect_win_(sysmon|secevt|pwsh)_","") | sort 0 - runtime_seconds | head 10 | table analytic runtime_seconds
| inputlookup detection_catalog | eval band=case(risk_score>=75,"75-90 / high",risk_score>=60,"60-70 / elevated",1=1,"45-55 / medium") | stats count as analytics by band

| inputlookup detection_catalog | makemv delim=";" mitre_techniques | mvexpand mitre_techniques | stats count as analytics max(risk_score) as max_risk by mitre_techniques | sort 0 - max_risk - analytics

| inputlookup detection_catalog | eval source_family=case(like(data_source,"%sysmon%"),"Sysmon Operational",like(data_source,"%Security%"),"Windows Security",like(data_source,"%PowerShell%"),"PowerShell Operational",1=1,"Other") | stats count as analytics by source_family

| inputlookup detection_catalog | eval saved_search="detect_".replace(detection_id,"\.","_") | lookup detection_validation saved_search OUTPUT result_count event_count scan_count runtime_seconds validation_state validated_at replay_id | eval verdict=case(validation_state="PASS_POSITIVE","PASS / MATCHED",validation_state="PASS_ZERO","PASS / OUT OF SCENARIO",1=1,coalesce(validation_state,"NOT RUN")) | table verdict title mitre_techniques severity risk_score result_count event_count scan_count runtime_seconds status validated_at | sort 0 verdict - risk_score

| inputlookup detection_catalog | eval saved_search="detect_".replace(detection_id,"\.","_") | lookup detection_validation saved_search OUTPUT validation_state result_count runtime_seconds | eval evidence=if(evidence_count>0,evidence_count." committed capture(s)","spec + live dispatch") | table status detection_id title severity risk_score mitre_techniques data_source schedule evidence validation_state result_count runtime_seconds source_path | sort 0 - risk_score title

div.p: ATT&CK mapping, required fields, false-positive model and response notes.
Application archive, lookup catalog, XML parsing and SHA-256 manifest.
Controlled concurrency, fatal-message gate, count and runtime capture.
Positive scenario, tuning decision and committed proof control promotion.
